step1_analysis.description: A differential cross-coupled latch with set and reset inputs, forming the core of a Conditional-Capture Flip-Flop (CCFF). It uses NMOS and PMOS transistors for conditional state flipping to achieve statistical power reduction.

paper_reference.title: Conditional-Capture Flip-Flop for Statistical Power Reduction

t_delay_set.description: Propagation delay from SET input (LABEL_NET_0) rising to Q output (N0) rising.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported (latency mentioned as small)

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay is roughly C_load * (VDD/2) / I_on. With W=5u, L=0.5u, C_load ~ 100fF and I_on ~ 2.5mA. Delay ~ 100fF * 0.9V / 2.5mA = 36ps. Parasitics will increase this slightly.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on sky130 NMOS drive strength and estimated node capacitance for the given W/L.

t_delay_reset.description: Propagation delay from RESET input (LABEL_NET_3) rising to Q_B output (N1) rising.

sky130_expected.calculation: Symmetric to t_delay_set due to identical transistor sizing.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The circuit is perfectly symmetric, so reset delay should match set delay.

power_avg.description: Average power consumption during continuous switching at 200 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power P = C_sw * VDD^2 * f. With C_sw ~ 100fF, VDD = 1.8V, f = 200MHz, P ~ 65uW. The paper's 2.2uW is likely due to a low activity factor (statistical power reduction) or smaller sizing. For continuous toggling, it will be higher.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for 1.8V supply and 100% activity factor in the testbench.

trip_point.description: DC switching threshold voltage of the SET input.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the ratio of NMOS pull-down (XM2) to PMOS pull-up (XM6). Since both have W=5u/L=0.5u, the NMOS is stronger (un ~ 3-5x up), skewing the trip point below VDD/2 (0.9V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard CMOS mobility ratios for equal-sized transistors.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure propagation delay, average power consumption, and DC switching threshold of the CCFF latch core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Conditional-Capture Flip-Flop Latch Core
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N1 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 N1 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Supplies and Node Tie-offs
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V_N2 N2 VDD 0
V_N3 N3 VDD 0
V_N4 N4 0 0
V_N5 N5 0 0

* Inputs for Transient Analysis (200 MHz)
V_L0 LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 50p 50p 1n 5n)
V_L1 LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1n 50p 50p 1n 5n)
V_L3 LABEL_NET_3 0 PULSE(0 1.8 3.5n 50p 50p 1n 5n)
V_L2 LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 3.5n 50p 50p 1n 5n)

* Initial Conditions
.ic v(N0)=0 v(N1)=1.8
.nodeset v(N0)=0 v(N1)=1.8

.control
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 15n
  meas tran t_delay_set trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran t_delay_reset trig v(LABEL_NET_3) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran i_avg avg i(VVDD)
  
  * DC Analysis for Trip Point
  dc V_L0 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc trip_point when v(N0)=0.9 rise=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
